seeds.vh-2-1-0-0: On the sun-bleached hemp catwalk of the outer rope market, an old skein-master ties a double-carrick bend around your bronze cargo frame to test its lashing strength.
seeds.vh-2-1-0-1: In the damp shade of the hemp-store, a winch-apprentice named Garrow offers you a steaming mug of pine-needle tea while you inspect the frayed hauling lines ahead.
seeds.vh-2-1-1-0: Beneath a canopy of swinging hemp coils, you balance the heavy Clapper across a trembling larch plank while winch-boys haul salted tallow overhead.
seeds.vh-2-1-1-1: Amidst the clatter of spinning jennies, a master cordwainer measures your bronze load against the spanning limits of the middle gorge.
seeds.vh-2-1-1-2: On a platform dangling above the abyss, a grease-stained hawser-tender warns you that the wind-whistle through the wire is screaming foul tonight.
seeds.vh-2-1-1-3: Beside a bin of tarred hemp scraps, you mend a chafed shoulder strap while a market crier advertises three-ply hemp for a groat.
seeds.vh-2-1-1-4: Because your guild-tied rope gleams with standard blue twine, the platform-warden waves you straight past the tariff barrier without checking your copper purse.
seeds.vh-2-1-1-5: Within the echoing hollow of a giant timber drum, you rest your tired mule while overhead cables sing an icy counterpoint to the bronze.
seeds.vh-2-1-2-0: Across a catwalk of woven wire, a spun-yarn vendor named Jael trades gossip about the broken bridge further down the gorge.
seeds.vh-2-1-2-1: In a narrow alcove hung with tallow buckets, you dodge a careening hand-cart loaded with heavy sisal bundles.
seeds.vh-2-1-2-2: Upon a windy staging post, an oiler named Corin splashes machine grease on your cradle runners to prevent salt-air seizing.
seeds.vh-2-1-2-3: Because you carry only plain unbranded hemp, the busy inspectors mistake you for a local messenger and let you slip through an unmonitored maintenance hatch.
seeds.vh-2-1-2-4: Beneath a fluttering fringe of drying flax, you share a dried mutton strip with an exhausted winch-tender named Hasty.
seeds.vh-2-1-2-5: Over a chasm of grey mist, a swaying rope-bridge dips sharply under the weight of an oncoming mule train.
seeds.vh-2-1-2-6: In the shadow of a giant turning capstan, you tighten your hip-belt as the bronze Clapper gives a low, sympathetic thrum.
seeds.vh-2-1-2-7: Beside a stacking yard of creosoted poles, a market bailiff checks your cargo tags for the proper municipal stamp.
seeds.vh-2-1-2-8: Across an open lattice of larch beams, you dodge the whipping tail of a slackened tow-line that hums like an angry hornet.
seeds.vh-2-1-2-9: Within a cavernous salt-shed, you brush white crusts off your leather boots while hawser-spinners chant rhythmically at their wheels.
seeds.vh-2-1-2-10: On a high ledge overlooking the lower precipice, a pulley-repairer hones a draw-knife near your mule's twitching ears.
seeds.vh-2-1-2-11: Beneath a web of guide-wires, a shivering child thrusts a handful of dried juniper berries toward your pocket for a half-penny.
seeds.vh-2-1-2-12: Upon a suspended trestle stage, you steady the vibrating cradle frame as a sudden thermal updraft rattles the scaffolding.
seeds.vh-2-1-2-13: Beside a pile of discarded coconut-fibre rope, an old splicer offers to whip your frayed pack-straps with waxed thread.
seeds.vh-2-1-2-14: Across a slippery brass-studded walkway, your lead-footed mule balks at a deep puddle of black axle grease.
seeds.vh-2-1-2-15: Within the drafty archway of a cable-house, you peer down into the grey void where the river foams three hundred feet below.
seeds.vh-2-1-3-0: On a swaying suspension walkway, a nervous weaver drops a shuttle that clatters down into the bottomless fog.
seeds.vh-2-1-3-1: Beside a row of smoking tar-pots, you catch your breath while an overseer berates a lazy pulley-boy.
seeds.vh-2-1-3-2: Across a narrow gap of open air, a basket-skiff loaded with mail bags slides past on a greased iron wire.
seeds.vh-2-1-3-3: Within a dim timber shelter, you adjust the bronze Clapper's canvas cover against a flurry of wet sleet.
seeds.vh-2-1-3-4: On a platform clamped directly to the cliff, a winch-master named Bran argues loudly with a toll-clerk over grease tariffs.
seeds.vh-2-1-3-5: Beneath a tangled canopy of guy-ropes, your mule's hoof strikes a loose iron spike with a sharp metallic ring.
seeds.vh-2-1-3-6: Beside an open winch-pit, you watch a massive braided towline wind slowly onto a hollow oak drum.
seeds.vh-2-1-3-7: Across a vibrating foot-bridge of split pine, a market guard taps his brass-headed truncheon against your bronze cradle.
seeds.vh-2-1-3-8: Within a sheltered alcove of hemp bales, you wipe condensation from your brow while checking your harness buckles.
seeds.vh-2-1-3-9: On an exposed stone staging, a gust of mountain wind catches the heavy Clapper and nearly turns you off balance.
seeds.vh-2-1-3-10: Beside a boiling vat of waterproofing pitch, an apprentice stirs the black brew with a notched pine paddle.
seeds.vh-2-1-3-11: Across a network of sagging suspension cables, you follow a sure-footed porter carrying crates of dried lichen.
seeds.vh-2-1-3-12: Within a vaulted transit shed, you rest your aching shoulders against a cold pillar of unhewn granite.
seeds.vh-2-1-3-13: On a frost-rimed wooden gallery, a toll-collector measures the thickness of your hauling lines with a brass gauge.
seeds.vh-2-1-3-14: Because you travel unburdened by the stubborn mule today, you easily squeeze through a narrow maintenance gap that blocks all pack-trains.
seeds.vh-2-1-3-15: Beside a stack of cedar shingles, an old rope-grader shakes his head at the salt damage on your leather frame.
seeds.vh-2-1-4-0: On the final approach to the checkpoint, a Cable Court sergeant blocks your path with a heavy iron-bound ledger.
seeds.vh-2-1-4-1: Before the triple-bolted gates of the toll-house, you wait while a clerk weighs a merchant's silver against standard scale.
seeds.vh-2-1-4-2: In the shadow of the tall granite customs tower, the air smells sharply of wet hemp and cold ledger ink.
seeds.vh-2-1-4-3: Beside the toll-house warden's high desk, a brass bell chimes whenever a new traveler steps onto the platform.
seeds.vh-2-1-4-4: Across the iron-plated threshold of the tax-office, you hear the scratch of steel nibs recording every pound of transit bronze.
seeds.vh-2-1-4-5: Within the narrow hallway of the toll-station, a debt-collector sharpens his quill while eyeing your bronze Clapper's cradle.
seeds.vh-2-1-4-6: On the windswept porch of the Cable Court, an armed bailiff bars your advance until your transit fee is settled.
seeds.vh-2-1-4-7: Facing the bronze-studded wicket of the central toll-house, you prepare to settle your account with the gorge authorities.
seeds.vh-2-1-5-0: At the Cable Court toll-house desk, you accept their bitter loan agreement, sealing a heavy debt with a fingerprint in red wax.
seeds.vh-2-1-5-1: Inside the cramped ledger-room of the toll-house, you sign the Cable Court's credit bond while a silent clerk notes your name for the repo-men.
seeds.vh-2-1-5-2: Before the high iron grating of the toll-house, you empty your heavy purse of earned groats to clear the crossing fee in hard cash.
seeds.vh-2-1-5-3: On the polished stone counter of the customs booth, you count out your last silver coins to pay the toll and keep your name off the loan ledgers.
seeds.vh-d-2-1: Enticed by a high-stakes dice game on a swaying rope-platform, you wager your sacred guild transit pass and lose it over the abyss to cheating card-sharks.
